race.description: Chris & Dale Harding Big Christmas Surprise Hcp (Bm50)
race.comment: LOUD (11) has not been winning lately, yet her profile at this venue is important: she is a track-and-trip winner and her wet-track record gives her a solid platform. READY FOR LIFT OFF (10) is the most consistent threat, beaten a neck by Brogans Creek at Mudgee after a strong Open third at Dubbo, and the 3kg claim keeps him very competitive. DODGE THE DARK (3) resumes after three months. Has a Warren BM58 win in the profile and is in the mix. CASINO STING (5) resumes off a Scone trial and has some stronger Class 1 form from last preparation, though three unplaced runs around 1100m keep him more of a place hope.
